rules: Paper only. No real money, wallets, exchange or DEX keys, sign-ups, posts, or messages.
No unattended live execution. The October live Solana desk stays off. mode.json is not edited.
Virtual bankroll $200. Max $10 per position. Max 2 open. No leverage. No averaging down.
Daily realized loss stop -$15 (America/New_York). Evaluation drawdown fail line -$40.
Missing or unverified data = reject. Fresh current-cycle sources and timestamps required.
Any disagreement or missing required seat vote = reject.
Exits written before entry: full stop -25%, full take-profit +50%, 24h time stop. No moonbag in this evaluation.
Hard rejects: honeypot; mint or freeze not renounced; rug_ratio > 0.25; bot_degen >= 0.75; failed liquidity or canonical-pool check; impersonation tickers; no quote.
Bear case required. Facts vs narrative; narrative cannot pass a gate.
No invented fills or marks. Corrections are new notes only.
Existing routines (paper-memecoin-team-cycle, memecoin sweeps) are not modified.
Until Zack decides otherwise, unwired Gemini/ChatGPT/Jev seats are missing votes and block fills (see the paper team plan, rule 14).
